source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the characteristics of populations (PDF 235).

blocks.text: Demography aabadiyon ki khasiyaton ka shumariyati mutala hai. Aabadi ka size is ki sab se ahem khasiyat hai kyunke yeh aabadi ke zinda rehne ki salahiyat se seedha juda hai.

blocks.explanation: Aabadiyon ki khasiyaton ka shumariyati mutala, jin mein size sab se ahem hai.

items: Demography: aabadiyon ki statistics; zinda rehne ke liye size sab se ahem.
